library(Seurat)

# Load 10X data from current directory
# Directory contains: barcodes.tsv (cell IDs), genes.tsv (gene IDs + symbols), matrix.mtx (UMI counts)
pbmc_data <- Read10X(data.dir = ".")

# Create Seurat object
# min.cells = 3: keep genes detected in at least 3 cells
# min.features = 200: keep cells with at least 200 detected genes
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = pbmc_data, project = "pbmc2700", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)

# Normalize data
pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

# Find variable features
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

# Scale data (centers and scales variable features)
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(pbmc))

# Run PCA
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(pbmc))

# Build KNN graph using first 10 PCs
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:10)

# Cluster cells with resolution 0.5
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)

# Run UMAP using first 10 PCs
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:10)

# Visualize clusters
DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE)

# Data structure: matrix.mtx (sparse matrix), barcodes.tsv (cell IDs), genes.tsv (gene IDs and symbols)
pbmc.data <- Read10X(data.dir = ".")

# Create Seurat object
# Rows: genes, Columns: cells
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = pbmc.data, project = "pbmc2700", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)

# Calculate mitochondrial QC metrics
pbmc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(pbmc, pattern = "^MT-")

# QC filtering: keep cells with 200-2500 features and <5% mitochondrial content
pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 2500 & percent.mt < 5)

# Normalize data
pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

# Identify highly variable features
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

# Scale data
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = rownames(pbmc))

# Run PCA
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))

# Clustering: construct KNN graph and find clusters
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:10)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)

# Run UMAP for visualization
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:10)

# Visualize UMAP
DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE)

# Find all marker genes for each cluster with log2FC threshold of 0.25
all.markers <- FindAllMarkers(pbmc, logfc.threshold = 0.25, min.pct = 0.1, only.pos = TRUE)

# Filter by adjusted p-value
significant.markers <- all.markers %>% filter(p_val_adj < 0.05)

# Display top markers per cluster
top.markers <- significant.markers %>% group_by(cluster) %>% top_n(n = 10, wt = avg_log2FC)
print(top.markers)

library(Seurat)
library(DoubletFinder)
library(Matrix)
library(ggplot2)

# Load 10X data from current directory
sc.data <- Read10X(data.dir = ".")

# Create Seurat object
sc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = sc.data, project = "pbmc3k", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)

# Add mitochondrial percentage
sc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(sc, pattern = "^MT-")

# QC filtering
sc <- subset(sc, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 2500 & percent.mt < 5)

# Normalization
sc <- NormalizeData(sc)

# Find variable features
sc <- FindVariableFeatures(sc, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

# Scale data
sc <- ScaleData(sc)

# Run PCA
sc <- RunPCA(sc, features = VariableFeatures(object = sc))

# Clustering
sc <- FindNeighbors(sc, dims = 1:10)
sc <- FindClusters(sc, resolution = 0.5)

# Run UMAP
sc <- RunUMAP(sc, dims = 1:10)

# DoubletFinder workflow
sweep.res.list <- paramSweep_v3(sc, PCs = 1:10, sct = FALSE)
sweep.stats <- summarizeSweep(sweep.res.list, GT = FALSE)
bcmvn <- find.pK(sweep.stats)

# Select optimal pK
pK_value <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))

# Estimate doublet rate
annotations <- sc@meta.data$seurat_clusters
homotypic.prop <- modelHomotypic(annotations)
nExp_poi <- round(0.075 * nrow(sc@meta.data))
nExp_poi.adj <- round(nExp_poi * (1 - homotypic.prop))

# Run DoubletFinder
sc <- doubletFinder_v3(sc, PCs = 1:10, pN = 0.25, pK = pK_value, nExp = nExp_poi.adj, reuse.pANN = FALSE, sct = FALSE)

# Get the classification column name
classification_col <- grep("^DF.classifications", colnames(sc@meta.data), value = TRUE)

# Visualize doublets on UMAP
DimPlot(sc, reduction = "umap", group.by = classification_col)

bcmvn <- find.pK(sweep.stats)

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

pbmc.data <- Read10X(data.dir = ".")

# Create Seurat object with filtering
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = pbmc.data, project = "pbmc2700", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)

# Calculate mitochondrial percentage
pbmc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(pbmc, pattern = "^MT-")

# Filter cells
pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 2500 & percent.mt < 5)

# Normalize data
pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

# Find variable features
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

# Scale data
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = rownames(pbmc))

# Run PCA
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))

# Find neighbors and clusters
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:10)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)

# Run UMAP
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:10)

# Find markers between cluster 0 and cluster 3
cluster0vs3.markers <- FindMarkers(pbmc, ident.1 = 0, ident.2 = 3, test.use = "wilcox")

# Prepare data for volcano plot
volcano.data <- cluster0vs3.markers
volcano.data$gene <- rownames(volcano.data)
volcano.data <- volcano.data[!is.na(volcano.data$avg_log2FC) & !is.infinite(volcano.data$avg_log2FC) & 
                             !is.na(volcano.data$p_val_adj) & !is.infinite(volcano.data$p_val_adj), ]

# Add significance column
volcano.data$significant <- ifelse(abs(volcano.data$avg_log2FC) > 1 & volcano.data$p_val_adj < 0.05, 
                                   "Significant", "Not Significant")

# Create volcano plot
ggplot(volcano.data, aes(x = avg_log2FC, y = -log10(p_val_adj), color = significant)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Not Significant" = "grey", "Significant" = "red")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  labs(title = "Volcano Plot: Cluster 0 vs Cluster 3",
       x = "Log2 Fold Change",
       y = "-Log10 Adjusted P-value") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

# Find variable features
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

# Scale data
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = rownames(pbmc))

# PCA
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))

# Find neighbors and clusters
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:10)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)

  "Significant",
  "Not Significant"
)

  scale_color_manual(values = c("Significant" = "red", "Not Significant" = "grey")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  labs(

  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(

    legend.position = "right"
  )

library(DoubletFinder)

# Load 10X data
pbmc.data <- Read10X(data.dir = ".")

# Create Seurat object with filtering
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = pbmc.data, project = "pbmc2700", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)

# Standard preprocessing workflow
pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc)
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc)
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))

# Clustering
set.seed(42)
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:30)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:30)

# DoubletFinder parameter sweep
sweep.res <- paramSweep_v3(pbmc, PCs = 1:30, sct = FALSE)
sweep.stats <- summarizeSweep(sweep.res, GT = FALSE)
bcmvn <- find.pK(sweep.stats)

# Select optimal pK
pK_value <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))

# Calculate expected doublets (assuming ~5.4% doublet rate for 2700 cells)
annotations <- pbmc@meta.data$seurat_clusters
homotypic.prop <- modelHomotypic(annotations)
nExp_poi <- round(0.054 * ncol(pbmc))
nExp_poi.adj <- round(nExp_poi * (1 - homotypic.prop))

# Run DoubletFinder
pbmc <- doubletFinder_v3(pbmc, PCs = 1:30, pN = 0.25, pK = pK_value, nExp = nExp_poi.adj, reuse.pANN = FALSE, sct = FALSE)

# Get the doublet classification column name
doublet_col <- grep("^DF.classifications", colnames(pbmc@meta.data), value = TRUE)

# Visualize doublets on UMAP
DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap", group.by = doublet_col, cols = c("red", "gray"))

library(Seurat)
library(DoubletFinder)
library(ggplot2)

# Load the PBMC dataset from working directory
# Files: barcodes.tsv, genes.tsv, matrix.mtx
sc.data <- Read10X(data.dir = ".")

# Create Seurat object with QC filters
# min.cells = 3: genes detected in at least 3 cells
# min.features = 200: cells with at least 200 detected genes
sc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = sc.data, project = "pbmc3k", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)

# Add mitochondrial percentage for QC
sc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(sc, pattern = "^MT-")

# Filter cells based on QC metrics
# nFeature_RNA: number of genes detected per cell
# percent.mt: percentage of mitochondrial genes
sc <- subset(sc, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 2500 & percent.mt < 5)

# Normalize data
sc <- NormalizeData(sc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

# Find variable features
sc <- FindVariableFeatures(sc, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

# Scale data
sc <- ScaleData(sc, features = rownames(sc))

# Run PCA
sc <- RunPCA(sc, features = VariableFeatures(object = sc))

# Find neighbors and clusters
sc <- FindNeighbors(sc, dims = 1:10)
sc <- FindClusters(sc, resolution = 0.5)

# Run UMAP
sc <- RunUMAP(sc, dims = 1:10)

# DoubletFinder: pK identification
sweep.res.list <- paramSweep_v3(sc, PCs = 1:10, sct = FALSE)
sweep.stats <- summarizeSweep(sweep.res.list, GT = FALSE)
bcmvn <- find.pK(sweep.stats)

# Plot BCmetric to identify optimal pK
ggplot(bcmvn, aes(pK, BCmetric, group = 1)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "pK Optimization", x = "pK", y = "BCmetric")

# Use optimal pK (typically the peak in BCmetric plot)
# For this example, using pK = 0.09 as commonly optimal
pK <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))

# Calculate expected number of doublets
# Assuming 7.5% doublet rate for ~3000 cells
annotations <- sc@meta.data$seurat_clusters
homotypic.prop <- modelHomotypic(annotations)
nExp_poi <- round(0.075 * nrow(sc@meta.data))
nExp_poi.adj <- round(nExp_poi * (1 - homotypic.prop))

# Run DoubletFinder
sc <- doubletFinder_v3(sc, PCs = 1:10, pN = 0.25, pK = pK, nExp = nExp_poi.adj, reuse.pANN = FALSE, sct = FALSE)

# Get the doublet classification column name (it's dynamically generated)
doublet_col <- colnames(sc@meta.data)[grep("DF.classifications", colnames(sc@meta.data))]

# Visualize doublets on UMAP
DimPlot(sc, reduction = "umap", group.by = doublet_col, pt.size = 0.5) +
  ggtitle("Doublet Detection Results") +
  theme_minimal()

# Create subset of singlets only
sc_singlets <- subset(sc, subset = sc@meta.data[[doublet_col]] == "Singlet")

# Visualize singlets only
DimPlot(sc_singlets, reduction = "umap", group.by = "seurat_clusters", pt.size = 0.5) +
  ggtitle("Singlets Only - Cluster Visualization") +
  theme_minimal()

# Summary statistics
cat("\nTotal cells:", ncol(sc), "\n")
cat("Singlets:", sum(sc@meta.data[[doublet_col]] == "Singlet"), "\n")
cat("Doublets:", sum(sc@meta.data[[doublet_col]] == "Doublet"), "\n")
cat("Doublet rate:", round(sum(sc@meta.data[[doublet_col]] == "Doublet") / ncol(sc) * 100, 2), "%\n")

library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Load 10X data from current directory
pbmc_data <- Read10X(data.dir = ".")

# Create Seurat object with filtering
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = pbmc_data, project = "PBMC2700", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)

# Normalize data
pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

# Find variable features
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

# Scale data
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc)

# Run PCA
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))

# Find neighbors and clusters
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:10)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)

# Run UMAP
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:10)

# Differential expression analysis between cluster 0 and cluster 3
cluster0_vs_3_markers <- FindMarkers(pbmc, ident.1 = 0, ident.2 = 3)

# Add gene names as column
cluster0_vs_3_markers$gene <- rownames(cluster0_vs_3_markers)

# Filter for significant genes and prepare for volcano plot
cluster0_vs_3_markers$significant <- ifelse(
  abs(cluster0_vs_3_markers$avg_log2FC) > 1 & cluster0_vs_3_markers$p_val_adj < 0.05,
  "Significant",
  "Not Significant"
)

# Handle zeros and NAs in p_val_adj for -log10 transformation
cluster0_vs_3_markers$p_val_adj[cluster0_vs_3_markers$p_val_adj == 0] <- .Machine$double.xmin
cluster0_vs_3_markers$neg_log10_padj <- -log10(cluster0_vs_3_markers$p_val_adj)

# Create volcano plot
volcano_plot <- ggplot(cluster0_vs_3_markers, aes(x = avg_log2FC, y = neg_log10_padj, color = significant)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Not Significant" = "grey", "Significant" = "red")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  labs(
    title = "Volcano Plot: Cluster 0 vs Cluster 3",
    x = "Log2 Fold Change",
    y = "-Log10(Adjusted P-value)",
    color = "Significance"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

print(volcano_plot)

# Display top significant genes
top_genes <- cluster0_vs_3_markers %>%
  filter(significant == "Significant") %>%
  arrange(p_val_adj) %>%
  head(10)

print(top_genes)

library(Seurat)
library(DoubletFinder)
library(ggplot2)

# Load 10X data from current directory
pbmc.data <- Read10X(data.dir = ".")

# Create Seurat object
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = pbmc.data, project = "pbmc", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)

# Standard preprocessing
pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc)
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc)

# Dimensionality reduction (required for DoubletFinder)
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:10)

# Find clusters for homotypic doublet estimation
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:10)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)

# Optimize pK parameter using paramSweep
sweep.res <- paramSweep_v3(pbmc, PCs = 1:10, sct = FALSE)
sweep.stats <- summarizeSweep(sweep.res, GT = FALSE)
bcmvn <- find.pK(sweep.stats)

# Select optimal pK
pK_optimal <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))

# Calculate expected doublets (7.5% rate for ~10K cells)
annotations <- pbmc@meta.data$seurat_clusters
homotypic.prop <- modelHomotypic(annotations)
nExp_poi <- round(0.075 * ncol(pbmc))
nExp_poi.adj <- round(nExp_poi * (1 - homotypic.prop))

# Run DoubletFinder
pbmc <- doubletFinder_v3(pbmc, PCs = 1:10, pN = 0.25, pK = pK_optimal, 
                         nExp = nExp_poi.adj, reuse.pANN = FALSE, sct = FALSE)

# Get classification column name (it's dynamically generated)
classification_col <- grep("^DF.classifications", colnames(pbmc@meta.data), value = TRUE)

# Visualize doublets
DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap", group.by = classification_col)

# Subset to keep only singlets
pbmc_singlets <- subset(pbmc, subset = pbmc@meta.data[[classification_col]] == "Singlet")

# Show summary
cat("Original cells:", ncol(pbmc), "\n")
cat("Singlets:", ncol(pbmc_singlets), "\n")
cat("Doublets removed:", ncol(pbmc) - ncol(pbmc_singlets), "\n")

# Visualize singlets only
DimPlot(pbmc_singlets, reduction = "umap", group.by = "seurat_clusters")

pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:10)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:10)

# pK parameter optimization
sweep.res.list <- paramSweep_v3(pbmc, PCs = 1:10, sct = FALSE)
sweep.stats <- summarizeSweep(sweep.res.list, GT = FALSE)
bcmvn <- find.pK(sweep.stats)

# Plot pK optimization
ggplot(bcmvn, aes(pK, BCmetric, group = 1)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  theme_minimal()

# Extract optimal pK
optimal.pk <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))

# Calculate expected doublets
annotations <- pbmc@meta.data$seurat_clusters
homotypic.prop <- modelHomotypic(annotations)
nExp_poi <- round(0.075 * nrow(pbmc@meta.data))
nExp_poi.adj <- round(nExp_poi * (1 - homotypic.prop))

# Run DoubletFinder
pbmc <- doubletFinder_v3(pbmc, PCs = 1:10, pN = 0.25, pK = optimal.pk, nExp = nExp_poi.adj, reuse.pANN = FALSE, sct = FALSE)

# Get classification column name
classification_col <- grep("^DF.classifications", colnames(pbmc@meta.data), value = TRUE)

# Visualize doublets
DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap", group.by = classification_col)

# Print doublet statistics
table(pbmc@meta.data[[classification_col]])

# Remove doublets
pbmc_singlet <- subset(pbmc, subset = !!sym(classification_col) == "Singlet")

# Visualize singlets only
DimPlot(pbmc_singlet, reduction = "umap", group.by = "seurat_clusters")

# Print final cell count
cat("Original cells:", ncol(pbmc), "\n")
cat("Singlet cells:", ncol(pbmc_singlet), "\n")
cat("Doublets removed:", ncol(pbmc) - ncol(pbmc_singlet), "\n")

# Read the Matrix Market format file
matrix <- readMM("matrix.mtx")

# Read barcodes and genes
barcodes <- read.table("barcodes.tsv", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
genes <- read.table("genes.tsv", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Set row and column names
rownames(matrix) <- genes$V2  # Use HGNC symbols
colnames(matrix) <- barcodes$V1

# Create Seurat object
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = matrix, 
                           project = "PBMC2700", 
                           min.cells = 3, 
                           min.features = 200)

cat("Loaded data with", ncol(pbmc), "cells and", nrow(pbmc), "genes\n")

# ============================================================================
# 2. QUALITY CONTROL
# ============================================================================

# Calculate mitochondrial percentage
pbmc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(pbmc, pattern = "^MT-")

# Visualize QC metrics
VlnPlot(pbmc, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3)

pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 2500 & percent.mt < 5)

pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

# Identify the 10 most highly variable genes
top10 <- head(VariableFeatures(pbmc), 10)
cat("Top 10 variable genes:", paste(top10, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# ============================================================================
# 5. SCALING
# ============================================================================

all.genes <- rownames(pbmc)
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = all.genes)

# ============================================================================
# 6. DIMENSIONALITY REDUCTION (PCA)
# ============================================================================

pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))

# Visualize PCA results
print(pbmc[["pca"]], dims = 1:5, nfeatures = 5)
DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "pca")

# Determine dimensionality
ElbowPlot(pbmc, ndims = 50)

# ============================================================================
# 7. CLUSTERING
# ============================================================================

# Use first 10 PCs (adjust based on ElbowPlot)
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:10)

homotypic.prop <- modelHomotypic(annotations)

                         sct = FALSE)

pANN_col <- grep("pANN", colnames(pbmc@meta.data), value = TRUE)

pbmc@meta.data$doublet_score <- pbmc@meta.data[[pANN_col]]

barcodes <- read.table("barcodes.tsv", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
genes <- read.table("genes.tsv", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Set row and column names
rownames(matrix) <- genes$V2  # Use HGNC symbols
colnames(matrix) <- barcodes$V1

# Create Seurat object
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = matrix, 
                           project = "PBMC2700", 
                           min.cells = 3, 
                           min.features = 200)

cat("Loaded data with", ncol(pbmc), "cells and", nrow(pbmc), "genes\n")

# ============================================================================
# 2. QUALITY CONTROL
# ============================================================================

# Calculate mitochondrial percentage
pbmc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(pbmc, pattern = "^MT-")

# Visualize QC metrics
VlnPlot(pbmc, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3)

# Filter cells based on QC metrics
pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 2500 & percent.mt < 5)

cat("After QC filtering:", ncol(pbmc), "cells remaining\n")

# ============================================================================
# 3. NORMALIZATION
# ============================================================================

pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

# ============================================================================
# 4. FEATURE SELECTION
# ============================================================================

pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

# Identify the 10 most highly variable genes
top10 <- head(VariableFeatures(pbmc), 10)
cat("Top 10 variable genes:", paste(top10, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# ============================================================================
# 5. SCALING
# ============================================================================

all.genes <- rownames(pbmc)
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = all.genes)

# ============================================================================
# 6. DIMENSIONALITY REDUCTION (PCA)
# ============================================================================

pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))

# Visualize PCA results
print(pbmc[["pca"]], dims = 1:5, nfeatures = 5)
DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "pca")

# Determine dimensionality
ElbowPlot(pbmc, ndims = 50)

# ============================================================================
# 7. CLUSTERING
# ============================================================================

# Use first 10 PCs (adjust based on ElbowPlot)
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:10)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)

# ============================================================================
# 8. UMAP
# ============================================================================

pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:10)

# 9. DOUBLET DETECTION WITH DOUBLETFINDER
# ============================================================================

cat("\n=== Running DoubletFinder ===\n")

# pK Identification (no ground-truth)
sweep.res.list <- paramSweep_v3(pbmc, PCs = 1:10, sct = FALSE)
sweep.stats <- summarizeSweep(sweep.res.list, GT = FALSE)
bcmvn <- find.pK(sweep.stats)

pK_optimal <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))
cat("Optimal pK:", pK_optimal, "\n")

# Homotypic Doublet Proportion Estimate
annotations <- pbmc@meta.data$seurat_clusters
homotypic.prop <- modelHomotypic(annotations)
cat("Homotypic doublet proportion:", homotypic.prop, "\n")

# Assuming 7.5% doublet formation rate (typical for ~8K cells loaded)
# Adjust based on your experimental setup
nExp_poi <- round(0.075 * ncol(pbmc))
nExp_poi.adj <- round(nExp_poi * (1 - homotypic.prop))

cat("Adjusted expected doublets:", nExp_poi.adj, "\n")

pbmc <- doubletFinder_v3(pbmc, 
                         PCs = 1:10, 
                         pN = 0.25, 
                         pK = pK_optimal, 
                         nExp = nExp_poi.adj, 
                         reuse.pANN = FALSE, 
                         sct = FALSE)

              cols = c("Singlet" = "#3498db", "Doublet" = "#e74c3c")) +
  ggtitle("PBMC 2700: Singlets vs Doublets") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))

p2 <- DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap", group.by = "seurat_clusters", label = TRUE) +
  ggtitle("Seurat Clusters") +
  theme_minimal()

p3 <- DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap", group.by = "doublet_classification",
              cols = c("Singlet" = "#3498db", "Doublet" = "#e74c3c")) +
  ggtitle("Doublet Classification") +
  theme_minimal()

# Display plots
print(p1)
print(p2 | p3)  # Side by side using patchwork

# Save plots
ggsave("umap_doublets.png", plot = p1, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
ggsave("umap_clusters_and_doublets.png", plot = p2 | p3, width = 14, height = 6, dpi = 300)

  mutate(
    significance = case_when(
      abs(avg_log2FC) > 1 & p_val_adj < 0.05 ~ "Significant",
      TRUE ~ "Not Significant"
    ),
    direction = case_when(
      avg_log2FC > 1 & p_val_adj < 0.05 ~ "Upregulated",
      avg_log2FC < -1 & p_val_adj < 0.05 ~ "Downregulated",
      TRUE ~ "Not Significant"
    ),
    neg_log10_padj = -log10(p_val_adj)
  )

pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 &

plot2 <- LabelPoints(plot = plot1, points = top10, repel = TRUE)
print(plot2)

# ============================================

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# ============================================
# 1. LOAD DATA
# ============================================
# Assuming your data is in a directory with matrix.mtx, genes.tsv, and barcodes.tsv
# Or you can load from a count matrix directly

# Option A: Load from 10X format
pbmc.data <- Read10X(data.dir = "path/to/your/data/")

# Option B: Load from a count matrix (rows = genes, columns = cells)
# pbmc.data <- read.table("your_count_matrix.txt", header = TRUE, row.names = 1)

# Create Seurat object
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = pbmc.data, 
                           project = "PBMC_scRNA", 
                           min.cells = 3,      # Keep genes expressed in >= 3 cells
                           min.features = 200) # Keep cells with >= 200 genes

# ============================================
# 2. QUALITY CONTROL
# ============================================
# Calculate mitochondrial percentage
pbmc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(pbmc, pattern = "^MT-")

# Visualize QC metrics
VlnPlot(pbmc, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3)

# Filter cells based on QC metrics
pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & 
                              nFeature_RNA < 2500 & 
                              percent.mt < 5)

# ============================================
# 3. NORMALIZATION
# ============================================
# Log-normalization (default method)
pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, 
                      normalization.method = "LogNormalize", 
                      scale.factor = 10000)

# Alternative: SCTransform (more advanced, recommended for newer analyses)
# pbmc <- SCTransform(pbmc, vars.to.regress = "percent.mt", verbose = FALSE)

# ============================================
# 4. IDENTIFY HIGHLY VARIABLE GENES
# ============================================
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, 
                              selection.method = "vst", 
                              nfeatures = 2000)

# Identify the 10 most highly variable genes
top10 <- head(VariableFeatures(pbmc), 10)
print(paste("Top 10 variable genes:", paste(top10, collapse = ", ")))

# Plot variable features
plot1 <- VariableFeaturePlot(pbmc)
plot2 <- LabelPoints(plot = plot1, points = top10, repel = TRUE)
print(plot2)

# ============================================
# 5. SCALING DATA
# ============================================
# Scale all genes
all.genes <- rownames(pbmc)
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = all.genes)

# Optional: Regress out unwanted sources of variation
# pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, vars.to.regress = c("percent.mt", "nCount_RNA"))

# ============================================
# 6. DIMENSIONALITY REDUCTION - PCA
# ============================================
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, 
               features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc),
               npcs = 50)

# Visualize PCA results
print(pbmc[["pca"]], dims = 1:5, nfeatures = 5)
VizDimLoadings(pbmc, dims = 1:2, reduction = "pca")
DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "pca")

# Elbow plot to determine dimensionality
ElbowPlot(pbmc, ndims = 50)

# Heatmap of PCs
DimHeatmap(pbmc, dims = 1:15, cells = 500, balanced = TRUE)

# ============================================
# 7. DETERMINE SIGNIFICANT PCs
# ============================================
# JackStraw procedure (computationally intensive)
# pbmc <- JackStraw(pbmc, num.replicate = 100, dims = 50)
# pbmc <- ScoreJackStraw(pbmc, dims = 1:50)
# JackStrawPlot(pbmc, dims = 1:20)

# ============================================
# 8. NON-LINEAR DIMENSIONALITY REDUCTION
# ============================================
# Choose number of PCs based on elbow plot (typically 10-30)
n_pcs <- 20

# Run UMAP
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:n_pcs)

# Run t-SNE
pbmc <- RunTSNE(pbmc, dims = 1:n_pcs)

# Visualize
p1 <- DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap") + ggtitle("UMAP")
p2 <- DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "tsne") + ggtitle("t-SNE")
print(p1)
print(p2)

# ============================================
# 9. SAVE PROCESSED DATA
# ============================================
saveRDS(pbmc, file = "pbmc_processed.rds")

# Export normalized counts
normalized_counts <- GetAssayData(pbmc, slot = "data")
write.csv(as.matrix(normalized_counts), "normalized_counts.csv")

# Export variable genes
variable_genes <- VariableFeatures(pbmc)
write.csv(variable_genes, "variable_genes.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Export PCA coordinates
pca_coords <- Embeddings(pbmc, reduction = "pca")
write.csv(pca_coords, "pca_coordinates.csv")

# Export UMAP coordinates
umap_coords <- Embeddings(pbmc, reduction = "umap")
write.csv(umap_coords, "umap_coordinates.csv")

# ============================================
# 10. SUMMARY STATISTICS
# ============================================
cat("\n=== Analysis Summary ===\n")
cat("Number of cells:", ncol(pbmc), "\n")
cat("Number of genes:", nrow(pbmc), "\n")
cat("Number of variable genes:", length(VariableFeatures(pbmc)), "\n")
cat("PCs used for UMAP/t-SNE:", n_pcs, "\n")

VlnPlot(pbmc, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"),

# Feature scatter plots

plot2 <- FeatureScatter(pbmc, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA")
plot1 + plot2

# Filter cells based on QC metrics

                              nFeature_RNA < 2500 & 
                              percent.mt < 5)

# ============================================================================

                      scale.factor = 10000)

# ============================================================================

                             nfeatures = 2000)

plot2 <- LabelPoints(plot = plot1, points = top10, repel = TRUE)
plot2

# ============================================================================

print(pbmc[["pca"]], dims = 1:5, nfeatures = 5)
VizDimLoadings(pbmc, dims = 1:2, reduction = "pca")
DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "pca")
DimHeatmap(pbmc, dims = 1:15, cells = 500, balanced = TRUE)

# Determine dimensionality
ElbowPlot(pbmc, ndims = 50)

# ============================================================================
# 5. CLUSTERING
# ============================================================================

# Find neighbors and clusters
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:20)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)

                               logfc.threshold = 0.25)

  group_by(cluster) %>%
  slice_max(n = 10, order_by = avg_log2FC)

top5 <- pbmc.markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  slice_max(n = 5, order_by = avg_log2FC)

library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(EnhancedVolcano)
library(pheatmap)

# Assuming you have a Seurat object named 'pbmc'
# If loading from file:
# pbmc <- readRDS("pbmc_seurat_object.rds")

# ============================================
# 1. DIFFERENTIAL EXPRESSION ANALYSIS
# ============================================

# Define clusters to compare (e.g., cluster 0 vs cluster 1)
cluster1 <- 0
cluster2 <- 1

# Perform differential expression using Wilcoxon Rank Sum test
de_markers <- FindMarkers(
  object = pbmc,
  ident.1 = cluster1,
  ident.2 = cluster2,
  test.use = "wilcox",
  logfc.threshold = 0.25,
  min.pct = 0.1,
  only.pos = FALSE
)

# Add gene names as a column
de_markers$gene <- rownames(de_markers)

# Filter significant genes (adjusted p-value < 0.05)
sig_markers <- de_markers %>%
  filter(p_val_adj < 0.05) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(avg_log2FC)))

# View top upregulated and downregulated genes
top_up <- head(sig_markers %>% filter(avg_log2FC > 0), 10)
top_down <- head(sig_markers %>% filter(avg_log2FC < 0), 10)

print("Top 10 Upregulated Genes:")
print(top_up)
print("Top 10 Downregulated Genes:")
print(top_down)

# ============================================
# 2. VOLCANO PLOT
# ============================================

# Create volcano plot
volcano_plot <- EnhancedVolcano(
  de_markers,
  lab = rownames(de_markers),
  x = 'avg_log2FC',
  y = 'p_val_adj',
  title = paste0('Cluster ', cluster1, ' vs Cluster ', cluster2),
  pCutoff = 0.05,
  FCcutoff = 0.5,
  pointSize = 2.0,
  labSize = 4.0,
  col = c('grey30', 'forestgreen', 'royalblue', 'red2'),
  colAlpha = 0.5,
  legendPosition = 'right',
  legendLabSize = 12,
  legendIconSize = 4.0
)

print(volcano_plot)
ggsave("volcano_plot.png", volcano_plot, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)

# ============================================
# 3. HEATMAP OF TOP MARKERS
# ============================================

# Select top 20 differentially expressed genes
top_genes <- sig_markers %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(avg_log2FC))) %>%
  head(20) %>%
  pull(gene)

# Extract expression data for these genes
Idents(pbmc) <- pbmc$seurat_clusters
cells_cluster1 <- WhichCells(pbmc, idents = cluster1)
cells_cluster2 <- WhichCells(pbmc, idents = cluster2)

# Get average expression per cluster
avg_exp <- AverageExpression(
  pbmc,
  features = top_genes,
  group.by = "seurat_clusters"
)$RNA

# Create heatmap
pheatmap(
  avg_exp[, c(as.character(cluster1), as.character(cluster2))],
  scale = "row",
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(100),
  main = "Top 20 DE Genes",
  fontsize = 10,
  filename = "heatmap_top_genes.png",
  width = 6,
  height = 10
)

# ============================================
# 4. VIOLIN PLOTS FOR TOP GENES
# ============================================

# Create violin plots for top 6 genes
top_6_genes <- head(top_genes, 6)

violin_plots <- VlnPlot(
  pbmc,
  features = top_6_genes,
  idents = c(cluster1, cluster2),
  ncol = 3,
  pt.size = 0.1
)

print(violin_plots)
ggsave("violin_plots_top_genes.png", violin_plots, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)

# ============================================
# 5. FEATURE PLOTS (UMAP)
# ============================================

feature_plot <- FeaturePlot(
  pbmc,
  features = top_6_genes,
  ncol = 3,
  reduction = "umap"
)

print(feature_plot)
ggsave("feature_plots_umap.png", feature_plot, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)

# ============================================
# 6. DOT PLOT
# ============================================

dot_plot <- DotPlot(
  pbmc,
  features = top_genes,
  idents = c(cluster1, cluster2),
  cols = c("lightgrey", "red"),
  dot.scale = 8
) + RotatedAxis()

print(dot_plot)
ggsave("dot_plot_top_genes.png", dot_plot, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)

# ============================================
# 7. EXPORT RESULTS
# ============================================

# Save all DE results
write.csv(de_markers, "DE_results_all.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(sig_markers, "DE_results_significant.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Create summary statistics
summary_stats <- data.frame(
  Total_Genes_Tested = nrow(de_markers),
  Significant_Genes = nrow(sig_markers),
  Upregulated = sum(sig_markers$avg_log2FC > 0),
  Downregulated = sum(sig_markers$avg_log2FC < 0),
  Mean_LogFC = mean(sig_markers$avg_log2FC)
)

write.csv(summary_stats, "DE_summary_statistics.csv", row.names = FALSE)

print("Analysis complete! All plots and results saved.")

dir.create(file.path(config$output_dir, "objects"), showWarnings = FALSE)

log_message <- function(msg) {
  timestamp <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
  message <- paste0("[", timestamp, "] ", msg)
  cat(message, "\n")
  cat(message, "\n", file = log_file, append = TRUE)
}

log_message("Starting Seurat analysis pipeline")

# =============================================================================
# 1. DATA LOADING
# =============================================================================

# Option 1: 10X format

  counts <- Read10X(data.dir = file.path(config$input_dir, "filtered_feature_bc_matrix"))
} else if (file.exists(file.path(config$input_dir, "matrix.mtx"))) {
  # Option 2: Matrix Market format
  counts <- readMM(file.path(config$input_dir, "matrix.mtx"))
  genes <- read.table(file.path(config$input_dir, "genes.tsv"),

  barcodes <- read.table(file.path(config$input_dir, "barcodes.tsv"),

                    col.names = c("gene_id", "gene_symbol"))

colnames(mat) <- barcodes$V1

pbmc[["gene_symbol"]] <- genes$gene_symbol[match(rownames(pbmc), genes$gene_id)]

pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = rownames(pbmc))
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc), npcs = 30)

# Clustering
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:10)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)

# UMAP embedding using first 10 PCs
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:10)

DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap", group.by = "seurat_clusters", label = TRUE, label.size = 3) +

# Read data
barcodes <- read.delim("barcodes.tsv", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
genes   <- read.delim("genes.tsv", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
counts  <- readMM("matrix.mtx")

# Assign row and column names
rownames(counts) <- genes$V2  # HGNC symbols
colnames(counts) <- barcodes$V1

# Create Seurat object
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts, project = "PBMC", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)

# Standard Seurat preprocessing
pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = rownames(pbmc))
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:30)
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:30)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)

# DoubletFinder parameters
pbmc <- paramSweep_v3(pbmc, PCs = 1:30, sct = FALSE, nExp = 0.25, PCsToUse = 1:30)
sweep_res <- summarizeSweep_v3(pbmc, PCs = 1:30, sct = FALSE, nExp = 0.25)
bcmvn <- find.pK(pbmc, PCs = 1:30, sct = FALSE, nExp = 0.25)

# Choose pK (here we pick the median of the top 5 pK values)
pK <- median(bcmvn$pK[which(bcmvn$BCmetric == max(bcmvn$BCmetric))])

# Run DoubletFinder
pbmc <- doubletFinder_v3(pbmc, PCs = 1:30, pN = 0.25, pK = pK, nExp = 0.25, reuse.pANN = FALSE, sct = FALSE, PCsToUse = 1:30)

# Add doublet classification to metadata
pbmc$doublet_class <- pbmc$DF.classifications_0.25_0.25_0.25

# Visualize UMAP colored by doublet status
DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap", group.by = "doublet_class") + ggtitle("UMAP: Singlets vs Doublets")

# 1. Load PBMC data (assuming 10X Genomics format)
pbmc.data <- Read10X(data.dir = "path/to/10x/data")
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = pbmc.data, project = "PBMC", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)

# 2. Add metadata: percent mitochondrial genes
pbmc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(pbmc, pattern = "^MT-")

# 3. QC filtering
pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 2500 & percent.mt < 5)

# 4. Normalization
pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

# 5. Identify highly variable features
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

# 6. Scaling
all.genes <- rownames(pbmc)
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = all.genes)

# 7. PCA
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))

# 8. Determine dimensionality (ElbowPlot)
ElbowPlot(pbmc)

# 9. UMAP
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:20)

# 10. Clustering
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:20)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)

DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, pt.size = 0.5) + NoLegend()

DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, pt.size = 0.5) + NoLegend()

# 16. Save Seurat object
saveRDS(pbmc, file = "PBMC_seurat_object.rds")

library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)

# Load your Seurat object (replace "pbmc_seurat.rds" with your file)
pbmc <- readRDS("pbmc_seurat.rds")

# Find markers for each cluster
markers <- FindAllMarkers(pbmc, only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25)

# View top markers per cluster
top_markers <- markers %>% group_by(cluster) %>% top_n(n = 10, wt = avg_log2FC)

# Basic cell type annotation using known markers
celltype_markers <- list(
  "CD4 T" = c("IL7R", "CCR7"),
  "CD8 T" = c("NKG7", "GZMB"),
  "NK" = c("NCAM1", "KLRD1"),
  "B" = c("MS4A1", "CD79A"),
  "Monocyte" = c("LYZ", "S100A8"),
  "Dendritic" = c("FCER1A", "CLEC10A"),
  "Megakaryocyte" = c("PPBP", "PF4")
)

# Assign cell type based on marker expression
pbmc$cell_type <- NA
for (ct in names(celltype_markers)) {
  pbmc$cell_type[which(
    rowSums(pbmc@assays$RNA@data[celltype_markers[[ct]], ] > 0) > 0
  )] <- ct
}

# Add annotations to metadata
pbmc@meta.data$cell_type <- pbmc$cell_type

# Save updated Seurat object
saveRDS(pbmc, file = "pbmc_annotated.rds")

counts <- read.csv("counts_matrix.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)

# Create Seurat object
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts, project = "PBMC", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)

# Add percent mitochondrial genes
pbmc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(pbmc, pattern = "^MT-")

# Visualize QC metrics
pdf(file.path(output_dir, "QC_violin_plots.pdf"))
VlnPlot(pbmc, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3)
dev.off()

# Filter cells
pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 2500 & percent.mt < 5)

# Normalize data using SCTransform
pbmc <- SCTransform(pbmc, verbose = FALSE)

# Run PCA
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, verbose = FALSE)

# Determine dimensionality
pdf(file.path(output_dir, "ElbowPlot.pdf"))
ElbowPlot(pbmc, ndims = 50)
dev.off()

# Find neighbors and clusters
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:20, verbose = FALSE)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5, verbose = FALSE)

# Run UMAP
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:20, verbose = FALSE)

# Save Seurat object
saveRDS(pbmc, file = file.path(output_dir, "pbmc_seurat_object.rds"))
SaveH5Seurat(pbmc, filename = file.path(output_dir, "pbmc_seurat_object.h5Seurat"))

ggsave(filename = file.path(output_dir, "UMAP_clusters.png"), plot = umap_cluster_plot, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)

umap_mt_plot <- DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap", group.by = "percent.mt", pt.size = 0.5) + ggtitle("UMAP - %MT")
